title: danthonia brachyathera
intro: Danthonia brachyathera, commonly known as Blue Wildrye, is a species of grass native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Blue Wildrye are attributed to its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
